scope: MCP tool definition isolation and inert repository file responses, plus a three-repository study refresh.

negativeControls.command: bun run test test/mcp.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'negotiated SDK|entire tools page|page metadata'
negativeControls.failure: The SDK rejected the whole tools/list result when one tool had a non-object inputSchema; valid tools and later pages were unavailable.

negativeControls.command: bun run test test/fs.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'sandboxes repository documents'
negativeControls.failure: Expected content-security-policy sandbox on an inert HTML file; received null.

checks.command: bun run test test/mcp.test.ts test/mcp-oauth.test.ts test/mcp-vault.test.ts test/mcp-instructions.test.ts test/mcp-import-boundary.test.ts test/plugin/mcp-codemode-defaults.test.ts

coverage: Negotiated MCP-era validation retains every definition the SDK accepts, including era-specific differences.
A valid tool remains callable after malformed definitions are removed.
An entirely invalid page retains its cursor so the following valid page is loaded.
Invalid page metadata still fails instead of being silently repaired.
File sandbox/nosniff headers cover HTML/SVG, HEAD, 200, 206, 304 and 416.
Existing file tests preserve MIME, validators, confinement, MCP Location reuse, and multi-megabyte full/range byte integrity.
limits: Local Linux verification; no native Windows run is inferred.
HTTP headers checked using inert documents; no browser exploit, visual browser test or third-party execution.
No paid provider calls, ambient provider activation, installed configuration edits or service restarts.
No public Protocol or HttpApi schema changed; generated client surfaces are unchanged.
Changeset recorded for the existing main release workflow; no release publication requested or performed.
OpenBot remains a functional reference; none of its source was incorporated.
Shared context versioning, grouped completions, cross-host graph linkage and other tracked feature gaps remain pending.

ci.note: Native Linux/Windows and other remote checks must be read from the workflow for the pushed commit.
